AfterImage (Wolf Studios)
games.summary: A puzzle platformer where every attempt you record replays as a solid, physical actor - and the way up is built out of them. Leave an echo of your run and stand on it. Build levels in the same physics and publish them; the server re-simulates your clear before anyone else can play it.

games.name: bansoko: Class Crossing
games.summary: An RPG-style party-following puzzle game. Your companions carry out your commands with a delay. Class-change with cute costumes!

games.name: Beast Market
games.summary: An idle hunting RPG built around the Steam Community Market. Your hunters automatically slay beasts and gather materials while you're away. Return to check market prices, trade your loot on the Steam Community Market, and decide what to hunt next. The hunt is idle—the trading is yours.

games.name: Bits Of Love: An Otome Game
Bomb Farm
games.summary: An idle mining RPG where your squad of bombers farms for you 24/7 . Blast rocks, hunt rare loot, forge and upgrade your gear, master a massive skill tree, and trade items with other players on the Steam Market. Free to play

games.name: Can I Take Your Order
games.summary: You and your friends play as part time waiters in different restaurants. Use your bare hands to deliver food, taze a raging cowboy who just shot someone and dispose of the body before it starts to stink. Keep your customers happy on your own, or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

games.name: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters
games.summary:
The next episode of Tsubasa’s riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. 

CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WOLRD FIGHTERS invites fans to follow their journey to victory by creating their own character and joining Tsubasa on his quest. Players will forge new friendships, fight new rivals, and bring the trophy back home.

Action on the field has been significantly enhanced for this new release. New super moves increase the intensity of every part of the game, allowing players to dominate the field when they pass, dribble, tackle or block with their own special techniques.

Even blocking goal shots becomes more tactical with a new system that pits goalkeeper against shooter, letting both players experience and counter jaw dropping super shots and blocks from characters of the original series.

games.name: Catenoid - Wormhole Chess
games.summary: Catenoid - Wormhole Chess is a non-Euclidean chess variant where two boards connect through a central wormhole. Pieces slide between dimensions. Pentagons block your path.

games.name: Ceramic - Stainless Steel - Neurotransmitter
games.summary: A short interactive novel. There is no "truth" in this game. This is not an armchair detective story—it is simply about a girl in a stall. You will advise the protagonist, determine how she perceives everything around her, and witness her ending.

games.name: Chronicles of the Fallen Realm
games.summary: Nine Hero classes. Five Acts of darkness. One Shadow Lord. Chronicles of the Fallen Realm is a dark fantasy turn-based RPG roguelite where defeat fuels your rise. Upgrade your Heroes, master unique skills, and push deeper into the Fallen Realm each run.

games.name: Daily War Online
games.summary: Daily War — Build an island fortress tile by tile, design its defenses, and declare war on ELO-matched rivals. Drop a battle card to bend the rules, then watch the clash unfold. No twitch reflexes — just sharp building and smart timing. One war a day. Make it count.

games.name: Devil Worm
games.summary: Arcade style 3d worm adventure game where mission is to eat material and get snake bigger and also collect bottles.

games.name: Dirtnap
games.summary: Dig, fly and fight through fully destructible maps in multiple game modes. Every character has its own unique ability, every biome its own hazards, and the weapon arsenal runs from machine guns to banana bombs to airstrikes. Play with friends, strangers, bots, or all of them.

games.name: Forgotten Haven: The First Call
games.summary: In a peaceful first-person fantasy puzzle adventure, find and pick up scattered pieces, then rotate and place them to restore 51 forms. Every object, creature, building, and guardian you restore remains in the forgotten haven. Fill it at your own pace, with no combat gameplay or time limits.

games.name: Garden of Witches
games.summary: Garden of Witches is a cute roguelike action game full of danger. Help the protagonist, Sil, as she tries to round up her unruly fellow witches and save the Garden.

games.name: Gods Shall Tremble
games.summary: Gods Shall Tremble is a deep, text-based gladiator management sim. Program granular fight plans, balance 16 stats, 67.5 Million Behavioural Combinations and loot 15 Million unique items to compete in multiple PvE modes, PvP leaderboards, and friendly and permadeath tournaments to cement your legacy.

games.name: Great Northern War
games.summary: Fight for mastery of the Baltic in a tactical wargame of aggressive Swedish assaults, Russian military reform, winter campaigns, and shifting alliances. Command Swedish, Russian, Danish-Norwegian, Saxon, Polish-Lithuanian, and allied forces across 89 scenarios, five campaigns, and the Scanian War.

games.name: Heroic Sports Football : Enhanced Edition
games.summary: With very few rules, on field fatalities and quick, hectic matches, Heroic Sports Football : Enhanced Edition is the remedy against stat-heavy, lumbering football simulations. It’s football the way it should be played. Pure brutal adrenaline charged fun.

games.name: Imperial Knights
games.summary: Become an imperial knight to reclaim your family's honor and discover what drove your sister to abandon her country!

games.name: KLAST
games.summary: KLAST is a fast twin-stick bullet-hell roguelite where every run transforms your ship. Chain kills, rescue survivors, collect powerful upgrades, and conquer three distinct campaigns filled with shifting arenas, relentless swarms, and colossal guardians.

games.name: Land of Winds
games.summary: This game is a fantasy style cultivation+MMORPG game, focusing on character development, pet matching, and guild territory confrontation. Players use forging and upgrading as the core growth line to participate in guild territory wars and win the title of king.

games.name: MAIMCOIL
games.summary: move fast → build weapon evolutions | crack elites + bosses | chase a high score | pixel-art bullet heaven | free updates forever

games.name: Mall Tidy Up Frenemies
games.summary: Chaos in, order out. Sort a mall's worth of misplaced products back onto the shelves they belong on, using each item's packaging as the clue. Unlock perks, climb the standings against your friends, and restore the whole mall in online co-op for up to eight, AI players included.

games.name: Megastore: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: Megastore: Tidy Up Together is a cozy sorting game for solo or co-op play. Take on 5 stores at any difficulty, from a Toy Store with 3,555 items to a massive Megastore with 13,357 items. Pick up, sort, shelve, and get ready to open!

games.name: Morgierra: Survivor
games.summary: A dark fantasy, bullet heaven roguelite where every battle is a test. But for what, and by whom? Enter the worlds of Morgierra, grow from desperate survivor to devastating force, seek what hides beyond the obvious path, and survive long enough to face the truth.

games.name: Mother;Above
games.summary: 48 hours before the floodgates open and drown the town to protect the City Above. Vik and his friends steal a maintenance tram through the wall. A short psychological horror VN about escape made useful.

games.name: Numble
games.summary: Numble takes the classic concept of Wordle and gives it a twist. This time it’s not about letters, but about cracking secret number codes.

games.name: Package chaos
games.summary: Package Chaos is a cozy package sorting game where you turn a messy warehouse into a perfectly organized delivery center.Pick up, inspect, sort thousands of unique packages and enjoy the satisfying feeling of a perfectly organized warehouse.

games.name: Pastimes
games.summary: Fill a grid of numbers to reveal Children's Games, the painting by Pieter Bruegel. Each number tells how many cells to fill in the 3×3 around it. One large puzzle, alone or with a partner in split-screen (Remote Play Together compatible).

games.name: Pley Okey
games.summary: Enjoy the classic game of Okey online with friends or play against AI. Create private rooms, improve your strategy, and experience a simple, polished version of this timeless tile game.

games.name: Pliant
games.summary: Eager and enthusiastic to start his career, join Terry as he shape-shifts his way through his first week at the Pliant Paper Co. Support your new co-workers by completing various tasks while navigating through cluttered, overgrown, and fire-riddled cubicles.

games.name: Rimi Kaikkonen Racing 60 Seconds
games.summary: Racing simulation where you are old F1 champions Rimi Kaikkonen and your mission is find beer bottle in different levels under 60 seconds in this arcade survival racing game

games.name: Salt & Schooners
games.summary: Washed ashore in 1789 on a chain of over 30 Pacific islands. Forage, hunt, build a fragile boat, and risk every journey as it constantly falls apart. Explore caves, shipwrecks, and underwater loot. Trade, fight tribes, and try to reach civilisation.. but nothing is free other than this game..

games.name: Shnik
games.summary: Get ready to slide, click and Shnik, colorful shapes through a little bead maze! Reunite the red ring with it's red center by manipulating the maze. Slide and rotate the rails, sort shapes, and unlock pieces to achieve your goal!

games.name: SlimeKitten
games.summary: SlimeKitten is a 2D precision platformer starring an adorable blob of slime. Aim each jump with a trajectory line, dial in your power and angle, and stick to walls as you flow through dozens of handcrafted levels. Take it slow and plan every leap, or chase the flawless speedrun.

games.name: SoberUp
games.summary: Pass the bottle or pass out. Hot potato, except the potato is alcohol and your friends are cowards. Sprint, tag, betray, sober up at the well — just don't be the first one to hit 100%.

games.name: Solipsistic
games.summary: Solipsistic is a free psychological horror game. Manipulate the game's files. The game knows you're there. The people inside it know it too.

games.name: Solve The Puzzle
games.summary: Solve The Puzzle - is a puzzle game that has up to 10 different levels to play. This is a single player game, the player reads the goal at the start of each level and tries to put the shapes at a specific state or position to achieve it.

games.name: Sound Syndicate
games.summary: Take on the role of a music manager and build your empire in Sound Syndicate by scouting raw talent, negotiating contracts, and managing rights.

games.name: Taproot
games.summary: A cozy first-person game about cleaning an overgrown property you've been away from too long. Pull carefully or the roots snap back and it all grows back. A short, complete afternoon of quiet work.

games.name: Taskbar Cat Club
games.summary: Adopt a club of pixel cats that live on your desktop. They stroll along your taskbar, nap on your monitors, climb your windows, chase your cursor, and wander from screen to screen, always on top and never in your way.

games.name: Terrarium II
games.summary: Terrarium II is a peaceful sandbox about exploring nature, collecting plants, and building your own garden. No enemies, no pressure—just a calm world where you can grow, craft, and create at your own pace.

games.name: The Brave Hearts II: False Skies
games.summary: Take to the skies in a fully voice-acted, story-driven top-down shoot 'em up. Battle enemy squadrons, survive intense arcade missions, master multiple aircraft, and push your score higher across campaign, training, hardcore, and endless modes.

games.name: The Last Cosmonaut
games.summary: The Last Cosmonaut is a first person survival horror puzzle game set in an abandoned lunar outpost. Collect parts, repair the escape vehicle, and keep the lights on, as something lurks in the shadows...

games.name: The Quiet Flat
games.summary: The Quiet Flat is a first-person psychological horror game set in an atmospheric Soviet apartment. Uncover the mystery of your father’s death as your familiar home slowly transforms into a nightmare

games.name: The Tower Of The Mad Wizard
games.summary: A first-person horror adventure with action and puzzle elements. Exploration is irremissible. Death is foretold.

games.name: Too Many Toys!
games.summary: Too Many Toys! is a cozy organizing simulator where you'll sort 5,599 toys in a messy toy shop. Put every toy back in its correct place, complete rows to gain points, and spend them on upgrades that make organizing faster and more satisfying!

games.name: Tornado: Research and Rescue - Red Truck DLC
Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Blood Moon
games.summary:
In ancient times, Saint Baal'Thasar had a vision of paradise, lit by a bright, red moon. And so he founded the Order of the Red Moon, to lead people to a land of eternal life. The myth says that Baal'Thasar found his paradise during a pilgrimage, and so never returned.

Having lost its leader, the Order shattered and many fringe sects were born from its remnants. Today, members of one of the most unscrupulous cults, Clan Bloodmoon, embarks on a journey to follow in Baal'Thasar's footsteps...

games.name: Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Bloodmoon
Windward Isles
games.summary: Trade, fight, and sail beyond the chart in a sun-drenched age-of-sail sandbox. Run cargo across ten living harbours, outgun corsairs with thundering broadsides, and rise from deckhand to legend — from a nimble cutter to a mighty man-o'-war.

Bread Makes the Heart Aflutter - The Baker's First Ball DLC
Craft. Sell. Goblin. Repeat. - Supporter Upgrade: Goblin skins
Crimson Moon
games.summary:
Ken, a high school student, is suddenly swallowed into another world, and he decides to take desperate action to rescue his younger sister.

In this strange world illuminated by the red moon, a terrible tragedy unfolds.... A tense search and a battle to the death await you.

Isekai survival horror RPG. defeat the enemy or escape, your decision will make the difference between life and death. A horror RPG with large character dots and a death-defying storyline.

games.name: Horse Spirit Valley 2
games.summary: Ride free through a living valley of meadows, forests, frost and dusk. Tame wild horses, style them in the Horse Boutique, collect gems, and explore five beautiful worlds in Horse Spirit Valley 2.

games.name: HyperCore: Rhythm Bullet Hell - Original Soundtrack
Not Quite Dead: Open World Survival
One Year of Special Lessons with My Little Sister Luri
Pioneer Autumn Outfits - WorldNeverland - Daily Life in the Elnea Kingdom - Another Life Adventure
Salvation: Echoes of War
games.summary: Explore a haunting purgatory in this third-person stealth adventure. Injured and trapped in a nightmare after war, solve puzzles, outsmart enemies, and rely on your loyal companion to find a way back to life. Can you escape your past and survive the echoes of war?

games.name: Superscalar Symphony - The soundtrack of Turing Complete
Zero Survivors: The Hero Must Die Demo
The Blood of Dawnwalker
games.summary:
Bringing together a talented team of developers, including members of the core team behind one of the most acclaimed games of all time - The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt along with its expansions, Rebel Wolves’ first title is a dark fantasy narrative sandbox, AAA action-RPG set in medieval Europe.

This brand-new IP is aimed at mature audiences and is powered by Unreal Engine 5.

games.name: Top Check: A Chess Card Game
Touhou Lensed Night Sky, Kaseigai Soundtrack
Beetleball - The Beetle Billionaire's Deluxe Golden Scarab Supporter Pack
BioEden
games.summary:
Welcome to BioEden, a cozy management game where you will build a self-sustaining network of structures, all working in harmony to bring extinct animals back to life. As a Keeper, you have been entrusted by the Cosmic Collective to bring life back to a planet quietly waiting to be healed. 

Upon your arrival, search for debris sites scattered across the land, they are the foundation of your journey. Recycle them into resources, and use those to build the base of your network: a solar energy system to generate electricity, and a water system to distribute it across all your buildings. Connect them together, weave a network across the land, and manage the supply and demand for every structure you create.

But plan with care. Each addition to your planet consumes resources, draws on energy, and nudges pollution upward. Find the balance between creation, exploration, and restraint, to accomplish the very mission that brought you here.

games.name: Cloudgazer: A Game About Watching Clouds
Hashire Hebereke: EX
games.summary:
Hashire HEBEREKE: EX is a modern remake of the 1994 Super Famicom game Hashire Hebereke by SUNSOFT.

Players can choose from a cast of quirky and adorable characters to race through item-filled, obstacle-packed courses. Local multiplayer supports up to four players, while online multiplayer supports up to eight players, ensuring fun and frantic competition.

games.name: Marsupilami 2 - Salsa Palombia
games.summary: A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and suddenly every animal starts dancing wildly, throwing the jungle into total chaos! Behind this rhythmic madness lurks the Mummy Queen, back from the Underworld with her crew to deliver a cursed concert with devastating effects. To restore peace to the jungle, take control of the three young Marsus, each with their own signature ability. Twister shoots through the air with a turbo glide, Hope leaps forward with an energetic spinning jump, and Punch bounces with powerful force to knock aside anything in his path! Switch instantly from one Marsu to another to unleash their powers and chain together stylish moves. And for even more fun, share the adventure with a friend thanks to local co‑op mode! From the Jungle to the City, from Snowy Mountains to the mysterious Underworld…explore four enchanting worlds packed with surprises, challenges, and unique gameplay mechanics. Beyond the main adventure, take on the Flow Mode, a speed-focused challenge where you must complete a series of trials without dying to prove your skills! And for even more fun, challenge your friends in competitive dojos.

games.name: Shoe it All!
games.summary: Launch shoes from a swing to solve clever physics puzzles. Master trick shots, uncover hidden secrets and discover smarter solutions with fewer throws.

games.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
games.summary:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice. With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.

Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.

Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

games.name: CONTROL Resonant
games.summary:
With Control, we leaped into the unknown. We wanted to create something new. Something different and unexpected. A world like no other. 

With Control 2, we'll take another leap into the unknown. It'll be an unexpected journey.

games.name: Silent Hill: Townfall
games.summary: SILENT HILL: Townfall, a co-production with Annapurna Interactive (Stray) and multiple BAFTA award winning No Code Studios (Stories Untold, Observation).

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.summary:
Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​ 

Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​

Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.
